Where is the nightlife on Koh Samui? | Chaweng is the centre, with the clubs on Soi Green Mango (nightly from about 21:00 to 04:00), ARKbar's beach fire shows from 20:00, live-band bars and two Muay Thai stadiums. Lamai has pubs and beach bars for an older crowd. Fisherman's Village, Bang Rak and the west coast are for beach clubs, fire shows and sunset bars.
Is Koh Samui's nightlife as good as Koh Phangan's? | It is different. Samui has more variety every night of the week: clubs, beach clubs, live bands, cabaret and Muay Thai, with better hotels and restaurants. Koh Phangan has the famous parties such as the Full Moon Party but quieter normal nights. Many visitors stay on Samui and take a return boat to Phangan for one party.
What time do bars close on Koh Samui? | Shops may sell alcohol from 11:00 to 24:00 since 29 May 2026. Licensed entertainment venues and hotel bars are exempt and stay open later: Chaweng's clubs on Soi Green Mango close at about 02:00–04:00, while most bars in Lamai and Fisherman's Village wind down between midnight and 02:00.
Can you buy alcohol on Buddhist holidays in Koh Samui? | Partly. On Buddhist holy-day bans, shops and 7-Eleven can't sell alcohol, but since May 2025 hotels, licensed bars and entertainment venues in tourist areas may still serve. There are no ban days in November or December 2026; the 2027 bans are 21 February, 20 May, 18–19 July and 15 October.
~Which nights are the Muay Thai fights in Chaweng? | Fights run six nights a week in Chaweng: Phetchbuncha Stadium on Monday, Wednesday and Saturday, and Samui International Muay Thai Stadium on Tuesday, Friday and Sunday, both from about 21:00. There are no fights on Thursday. Tickets cost 1,500, 2,000 and 2,500 THB in 2026; buy at the box office, not from touts.
Is Green Mango open every night? | Yes. The Green Mango Club on Soi Green Mango in Chaweng opens nightly, from about 21:00 (some listings say 22:00) until about 02:00–04:00, and is busiest after midnight. Entry is usually free, but you must be 20 or over, so bring ID or a passport copy. Saturday is the busiest night.
~How do I get to the Full Moon Party from Koh Samui? | Take a return boat with hotel pickup: our shared Full Moon Party speedboat costs 1,400 THB per person in 2026, with pickup from most areas of Samui and drop-off after the party. Groups of up to 10 can book a private boat. Public ferries have no late-night return. Entry, about 200 THB, is paid at the beach.
~Is Lamai good for nightlife? | Lamai is good for a relaxed night out, not for clubbing. Shamrock Irish Pub has a show band nightly from about 21:30 to 01:30, Rock Bar plays reggae and rock, and Teddy Weed runs beach parties until about 02:00. It suits an older crowd; Chaweng, a short ride north, is where the clubs are.
How do I get home at night on Koh Samui? | Grab works best in Chaweng, Bophut and Lamai, with surge prices late at night. Taxis don't use meters, so agree the fare first and expect 20–30 % more after 22:00. Songthaews mostly stop by 22:00. Never ride a scooter after drinking: police checkpoints are common and insurance won't cover you.
Is Koh Samui nightlife safe for solo women? | Generally yes in busy areas such as Chaweng Beach Road and Fisherman's Village, with sensible precautions. The UK Foreign Office warns of drink spiking and sexual assault in island party areas, so watch your drink, avoid walking alone on dark beaches, use Grab rather than unmarked rides, and save the Tourist Police number, 1155.
